title: Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators
abstract: arXiv:2608.30110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. translated_title: 大语言模型能感知经济的脉搏吗？大语言模型对宏观经济指标实时预测的评估
translated_abstract: 对头条宏观经济指标进行即时预测，即在官方发布之前估计该指标在当前参考期的数值，对货币政策和金融市场至关重要，各国央行都设有专门的经济学家团队来产出此类估计。大语言模型（LLM）智能体是完成这项任务的有前景的候选者，它结合了广泛的世界知识与实时网络搜索能力，并能以比机构即时预测更高的频率支持查询。然而，评估其即时预测能力具有挑战性：GDP和CPI等头条指标被广泛报道，很可能在预训练期间被模型记住，因此任何基于历史发布数据的评估都容易受到数据污染的影响。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了LiveMacroEval，这是一个实时、抗污染的基准，其中LLM智能体在官方发布前的窗口期内，对十六个主要的美国宏观经济指标进行每小时一次的即时预测。
tldr: 该论文提出了LiveMacroEval——一个实时、抗数据污染的基准，用于评估大语言模型智能体在官方发布前对十六个主要美国宏观经济指标进行每小时即时预测的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark that evaluates LLM agents' ability to produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators before their official release.
